notes: Only packet element is param:/robot_description (provides). No other packet elements, so references is empty; the package's launch files also name non-packet items (param controller_joint_names loaded from config/joint_names_sia20d.yaml, motoman_driver launch files, industrial_robot_client rviz config, xacro.py), which are outside the packet and not recorded.
